application: Source-run Electron 44.7.2 with a production UI build
method: Native desktop interaction through agent-browser/CDP on an Xvfb virtual display; disposable TRIBUTARY_DATA_DIR and project. No provider requests, real conversations or peer-hosting actions.

checks.name: Settings first open and close
checks.observed: Settings sections rendered after the first deferred load; Close settings removed the dialog.

checks.name: Team task retained across close/reopen
checks.observed: Entered 'Preserve this unsent team task across closing and reopening.'; Cancel and reopen returned exactly that value. No team was started.

checks.name: Changed chat draft seeds a new team task
checks.observed: Changed the chat draft to 'A fresh chat-seeded team task.'; the next team open used that exact new value.

checks.name: First source editor load and draft lifetime
checks.observed: Opened hello.js from the explorer; the deferred editor became editable. Edited text survived Memory -> Files switching. Saved a valid replacement through Save file and read the real fixture file back from disk.

checks.name: Saved document first open and unsaved-change guard
checks.observed: Save as document opened the lazy panel. An unsaved content edit triggered Discard unsaved changes on Close; Keep editing retained the content. Save changes reported Version 2 and then allowed closing.

checks.name: Terminal shell survives hide/reopen
checks.observed: Set TRIBUTARY_MEMORY_VERIFY=retained-session in Shell 1. Hid and reopened Terminal. Printing the variable returned retained-session and only Shell 1 was present; the existing scrollback remained visible.

checks.name: Project room first open
checks.observed: The deferred room displayed Host a room / Join a room setup and returned to the workspace. Hosting was not started.

checks.name: Failed module can close and keeps the workbench
checks.observed: Blocked only settings-dialog-*.js in this test browser, reloaded and opened Settings. The feature error appeared while chat/terminal stayed rendered. Close removed the error and the chat draft remained unchanged.

checks.name: Recovery after removing failed-module injection
checks.observed: Removed the test route and reloaded. Settings opened and closed normally. No alert or dialog remained; the chat draft was unchanged.

limits: Interaction checks, not RAM/startup/interaction-latency benchmarks. No packaged installer, macOS, Windows, real model inference, long-session heap stabilization or active remote collaboration was tested here. Static module exclusion is asserted separately by the bundle benchmark.
